lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy are having breakfast.
lines.zh: 佩奇、乔治、猪妈妈和猪爸爸在吃早餐。

lines.en: It is a lovely sunny day, and Peppa and George can't wait to go into the garden to play.
lines.zh: 今天阳光明媚，佩奇和乔治迫不及待想去花园玩。

lines.en: Mummy, please can we go out to play?
lines.zh: 妈妈，我们可以出去玩吗？

lines.en: You can go out to play when you finish your breakfast.
lines.zh: 你们吃完早餐就可以出去玩了。

lines.en: George, don't drink your juice too quickly.
lines.zh: 乔治，别把果汁喝得太快。

lines.en: George drank his juice too quickly, and now he has hiccups.
lines.zh: 乔治果汁喝得太快，现在他打嗝了。

lines.en: Can we go out to play now, Mummy?
lines.zh: 妈妈，我们现在可以出去玩了吗？

lines.en: Not while George has hiccups.
lines.zh: 乔治还在打嗝，不行。

lines.en: George's hiccups have gone, Mummy, haven't they?
lines.zh: 妈妈，乔治的嗝已经停了，对吧？

lines.en: Oh, all right, you can go out and play. But look after George.
lines.zh: 哦，好吧，你们可以出去玩。但要照顾好乔治。

lines.en: Peppa and George love playing in the garden.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢在花园里玩。

lines.en: George, I'm going to throw the ball, and then you have to catch it.
lines.zh: 乔治，我要把球扔出去，然后你要接住它。

lines.en: George, please stop hiccupping!
lines.zh: 乔治，别打嗝了！

lines.en: Now you throw the ball to me, and I have to catch it.
lines.zh: 现在你把球扔给我，我来接住。

lines.en: Oh dear, George's hiccups are spoiling the game.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪，乔治打嗝把游戏都弄糟了。

lines.en: George, I know how to cure hiccups. You have to do what I say.
lines.zh: 乔治，我知道怎么治打嗝。你要照我说的做。

lines.en: Rub the top of your head and rub your tummy.
lines.zh: 摸摸你的头顶，再揉揉你的肚子。

lines.en: Good. Now your hiccups have gone.
lines.zh: 很好。现在你的嗝停了。

lines.en: Peppa's cure for hiccups doesn't seem to have worked.
lines.zh: 佩奇治打嗝的办法好像不管用。

lines.en: George, you've done it all wrong. I know a better way to cure hiccups.
lines.zh: 乔治，你全做错了。我知道一个更好的治打嗝办法。

lines.en: First, jump up and down three times on one leg.
lines.zh: 首先，单脚跳三下。

lines.en: Now wave your arms up and down and stick your tongue out.
lines.zh: 现在上下挥动你的手臂，再把舌头伸出来。

lines.en: And now close your eyes and turn around quickly three times.
lines.zh: 然后闭上眼睛，快速地转三圈。

lines.en: Peppa's new cure hasn't worked either. George still has hiccups.
lines.zh: 佩奇的新办法也没用。乔治还在打嗝。

lines.en: I know how to cure hiccups. The ill piggy must be given a shock.
lines.zh: 我知道怎么治打嗝了。得让生病的小猪受点惊吓。

lines.en: George, I'm going to scare you. But you must remember it's only a game, and it'll stop your hiccups.
lines.zh: 乔治，我要吓你一跳。但你要记住这只是个游戏，这样你的嗝就会停。

lines.en: Remember, this is just pretend.
lines.zh: 记住，这只是假装而已。

lines.en: Peppa, you mustn't play so roughly with George. He's only little.
lines.zh: 佩奇，你不能跟乔治玩得这么粗鲁。他还小呢。

lines.en: Sorry, Mummy. I was just trying to stop George's hiccups.
lines.zh: 对不起，妈妈。我只是想让乔治不打嗝。

lines.en: George's hiccups have gone!
lines.zh: 乔治的嗝停了！

lines.en: Here comes Daddy Pig with two beakers of juice.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸拿着两杯果汁过来了。

lines.en: George, if you drink too quickly, you will get hiccups again.
lines.zh: 乔治，如果你喝得太快，又会打嗝的。

lines.en: I'm not as little as George. I can drink juice as quickly as I want to.
lines.zh: 我可不像乔治那么小。我想喝多快就喝多快。
